title: BSC Audit Engine: Fail-Closed Audit-Descent Kernel
description: Version 0.3.0-alpha.4 is a public research preview of a fail-closed structural checker for typed scientific claims. It restores the exact original derived-descent generators, adds a local-only accessible browser packet builder, and produces deterministic LLM-oriented publication assets without enlarging the engine's proof authority. A clear run means only that no implemented blocking condition fired on the declared input. This metadata applies to the Apache-2.0 software release assets; research material under research/ is separately governed by CC BY 4.0.
